z-m-03-01.title: Takarda siririya mai tsawo da takarda mai kumburi: wanne ne ya fi girman fili?
z-m-03-01.topic: Kwatanta fili (ɗora ɗaya a kan ɗaya, da kwatanta su da murabba'ai masu girma iri ɗaya)
z-m-03-01.goal: Kwatanta filin takardu biyu masu siffofi dabam-dabam ta hanyar duba da ido, ɗora ɗaya bisa ɗaya, da kwatanta su da murabba’ai masu girma iri ɗaya; ka gyara hukuncinka yayin da bayanai ke zuwa, sannan ka bayyana cewa ana buƙatar wata hanya idan ɗorawa bai yanke shawarar ba.
z-m-03-01.material: Akwai takardu biyu masu murabba’i, “가” da “나”, da aka yi da takarda mai kauri. “가” murabba’i ne mai tsawo a kwance, “나” kuma bai kai tsawon “가” ba amma ya fi fadi. Kana son gano wanne ya fi girman fili (girman sararin da takardar ta rufe). Ba ka auna tsawon su ba tukuna.
z-m-03-01.thinking.0: Bincika hukuncin da aka yi ta kallo da ido
z-m-03-01.thinking.1: Canza matakin tabbaci yayin da sabon bayani ke zuwa
z-m-03-01.prereq.0: Sanin “fadi/ƙunci” da kwatanta abubuwa biyu ta ɗora ɗaya bisa ɗaya (matakin aji na 1)
z-m-03-01.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki, zaɓi ra’ayinka game da wanne ya fi girman fili.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, faɗi abu guda game da “abin da ya yi daidai da abin da ya bambanta” a sabon abin da ka koya.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yanke takardun biyu da gaske sannan ka ɗora ɗaya bisa ɗaya, ka bi da yatsa wuraren da suka fito waje.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.info: An ajiye takardun biyu dabam a kan tebur, ka duba su da ido kawai. “가” yana kama da tsawo, “나” kuma kamar ya kumbura ne.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yanzu wanne kake ganin ya fi girman fili?
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Yana da wuya a yanke shawara daga yadda ido yake gani kawai. Ana buƙatar hanya kamar ɗora ɗaya bisa ɗaya ko kwatanta su da guntaye masu girma ɗaya.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 가 ya fi girma. Faɗinsa ya fi tsawo, don haka mai tsawo ya fi girma.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka duba tsawo ta hanya guda kawai. Domin fili, dole ne ka yi tunanin faɗi da tsawo tare.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ba za a iya sani daga kallo kawai ba. Dole ne a ɗora ɗaya bisa ɗaya ko a auna.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka fara tunanin hanyar bincike. Kyakkyawar ɗabi’a ce a bambanta jin rai da bincike.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: 나 ya fi girma. Ya fi kumbura, don haka ya yi kama da ya fi cikawa.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka yanke shawara bisa ji. Yana iya zama daidai, amma ba za a sani ba kafin a bincika.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Siffofin sun bambanta, don haka filayen ma lallai sun bambanta. Ba mu dai san wanda ya fi girma ba.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ko siffofin sun bambanta, filayen na iya zama iri ɗaya. Babu dalilin yin wannan ƙaƙƙarfan ikirari tukuna.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Ka ɗora “가” bisa “나” ka daidaita kusurwoyinsu na sama na hagu. “가” ya fito bayan “나” zuwa dama, “나” kuma ya fito bayan “가” zuwa ƙasa. Babu ɗaya da ya rufe ɗayan gaba ɗaya.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan ɗaya ya rufe ɗayan gaba ɗaya, za ka iya cewa wanda aka rufe yana da ƙaramin fili. Amma idan duka sun fito waje, yana da wuya a yanke shawara ta ɗorawa kaɗai.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 가 ya fi girma. Bangaren da ya fito waje yana da tsawo zuwa dama.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka kalli tsawon bangaren da ya fito waje kaɗai. Ka yi tunanin yadda “나” ya fito waje a ƙasa ma.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 나 ya fi girma. Bangaren da ya fito a ƙasa ya yi kama da ya fi kauri.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Yana iya zama haka a gani, amma ba ka kwatanta girman sassan biyun da suka fito waje ba tukuna.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Filayen biyun iri ɗaya ne. Sassan da suka fito waje sun yi kama da juna.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kamanceceniya ba dalili ba ce na cewa daidai suke. Wataƙila iri ɗaya ne, amma sai an ƙara bincike.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ba za a iya yanke hukunci ta ɗora ɗaya bisa ɗaya kawai ba. Ana buƙatar wata hanya ma.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ka lura cewa idan duka suka fito waje bayan an ɗora ɗaya bisa ɗaya, ba za a iya gane wanda ya fi girma nan take ba.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.info: A kan takardun biyun an zana ƙananan murabba’ai masu girma ɗaya ba tare da tazara ba. “가” yana da layuka 2, kowanne da murabba’ai 6 a faɗi; “나” yana da layuka 3, kowanne da murabba’ai 4 a faɗi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Idan aka kwatanta da murabba’ai, wanne ya fi girman fili?
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 가 yana da layuka 2 na murabba’ai 6, 나 kuma layuka 3 na murabba’ai 4, kuma murabba’ai iri ɗaya ne, don haka kowanne yana da murabba’ai 12. Saboda haka filayen iri ɗaya ne duk da siffofi dabam-dabam. Idan murabba’ai ba iri ɗaya ba ne, ba za a iya kwatanta ta wannan hanya ba.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Takardun biyun kowacce tana da murabba’ai 12, iri ɗaya, saboda haka filayen iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka kwatanta ta adadin dukan murabba’ai lokacin da murabba’ai suke da girma ɗaya. Ka yi tunanin siffa da fili a ware.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 가 ya fi girma. Akwai murabba’ai 6 a layi ɗaya, fiye da 4.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka kalli layi ɗaya kawai. Dole ne ka yi tunanin adadin layuka ma.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 나 ya fi girma. Akwai layuka 3, fiye da 2.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka kalli adadin layuka kawai. Dole ne ka yi tunanin murabba’ai nawa ne a kowane layi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Idan siffofin sun bambanta, ba za ka iya kwatanta filayensu ta ƙirga murabba’ai ba.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Idan murabba’ai suna da girma ɗaya, za ka iya kwatanta ta adadin murabba’ai duka, ko da siffofin sun bambanta.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.reflect: Yaya tunaninka ya canza daga lokacin da ka fara duba da ido, zuwa ɗorawa ɗaya bisa ɗaya, sannan kwatantawa da murabba’ai? Domin kwatanta da murabba’ai, me ya kamata ya yi daidai game da murabba’ai?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.prompt: Abokinka ya ce, “Siffofin sun bambanta, saboda haka filayen ma sun bambanta!” Me kake so ka gaya wa abokinka?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo ko akwai misali a cikin takardun da ka gani yanzu wanda yake nuna cewa bayanin abokinka ba daidai ba ne.
z-m-03-01.s.s2.hint.1: Da farko rubuta lambobin da za ka iya amfani da su a matsayin shaida ga wannan misali, sannan ka ƙirƙiri jumla.
z-m-03-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Lambobin da na rubuta a matsayin shaida (adadin murabba’ai, da sauransu) da gaske lambobi ne na takardun biyun?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana dabam “siffofin sun bambanta” da “filayen sun bambanta”?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana sharadin cewa murabba’ai suna da girma ɗaya?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.model.0: Dukansu suna da murabba’ai 12, saboda haka filayen iri ɗaya ne. Ko da siffofin sun bambanta, filayen na iya zama iri ɗaya.
z-m-03-01.s.s2.model.1: Ban iya sani ta ɗora ɗaya bisa ɗaya ba, amma da na ƙirga murabba’ai masu girma ɗaya, na ga 가 da 나 duka suna da murabba’ai 12. Saboda haka filayen iri ɗaya ne.

z-m-03-06.prereq.0: Ƙirga da tara lambobi har zuwa 10
z-m-03-06.title: Idan na duba daga sama na ga 3, guda nawa ne ke ɓoye a ƙasa?
z-m-03-06.topic: Siffofi da aka tara (tunani kan sassan da ba za ka iya gani ba)
z-m-03-06.goal: Tsara abin da za ka iya faɗa tabbatacce da wanda ba za ka iya faɗa ba daga kallon sama kaɗai, sannan ƙirƙiri hanyoyi da dama na tara su da ke kama da iri ɗaya daga sama kuma suke da jimillar tubalan iri ɗaya.
z-m-03-06.material: An gina hasumiyoyi uku gefe da gefe da tubalan girma iri ɗaya. Akwai ɗaya a hagu, ɗaya a tsakiya, ɗaya a dama. An tara kowace hasumiya daga ƙasa, kuma kowacce tana da matakai 1 zuwa 3. Idan aka duba daga sama, saman tubalin hasumiya ɗaya kawai ake gani. Ba za ka iya ganin daga sama yawan matakan tubalan da ke ƙasa ba.
z-m-03-06.thinking.0: Rarrabe abin da ka sani tabbatacce da wanda ba ka sani ba daga abin da kake iya gani
z-m-03-06.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar mafita da dama bisa sharuɗɗa
z-m-03-06.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa siffar ba ta canzawa
z-m-03-06.prereq.1: Sanin sama, ƙasa, hagu, da dama
z-m-03-06.s.s1.prompt: Daga kallon sama kaɗai ka sani. Zaɓi duk abin da za ka iya faɗa tabbatacce daga wannan.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.hint.0: Rarrabe tubalan da kake gani da waɗanda suke ɓoye a ƙasa.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.hint.1: Gwada ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko kowace magana kullum gaskiya ce ko da hasumiyoyin suna da adadin matakai daban-daban.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.a: Ka ƙirga tubalan saman da kake gani kawai. Ka yi tunanin ko akwai ƙarin tubalan a ƙananan matakai.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.b: Wannan gaskiya ce da za ka iya sani tabbatacce daga kallon sama. Sake duba ko akwai wani abu da ka rasa.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.d: Wannan gaskiya ce da za ka iya sani tabbatacce daga kallon sama. Sake duba ko akwai wani abu da ka rasa.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.c: Ka ɗauka tun farko cewa kowace hasumiya tana da matakai 2. Wani ya faɗi haka?
z-m-03-06.s.s1.o.e: Hasumiyar mafi tsawo tana da matakai 3.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.e: Matakai 3 ne kawai iyakar tsawon hasumiya, daga sama ba za ka iya ganin wace hasumiya ce take da matakai 3 ba.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.explain: Daga sama kana ganin tubalan saman 3 kawai, saboda haka abubuwan da ka sani tabbatacce su ne hasumiyoyi 3 ne kuma aƙalla tubalan 3 ne. Ƙananan matakai na iya bambanta daga 1 zuwa 3, jimilla kuma tana tsakanin 3 zuwa 9, saboda haka ba za ka faɗi ainihin adadin ba.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri hanyoyi daban-daban 3 na zaɓar adadin matakan hasumiyoyi ukun domin jimilla ta zama tubalan 7. Kallon daga sama dole ya kasance iri ɗaya.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko nemo yanayi guda inda adadin matakan hasumiyoyi ukun ya zama 7.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kowace hasumiya tana da matakai 1 zuwa 3. Ƙirƙiri wata hanya ta cire mataki daga hasumiya guda sannan a ƙara mataki ga wata.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.fail.c0: Dole adadin matakai ya zama lambar ƙirga kamar 1, 2, 3.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukkan hasumiyoyi ukun suna da matakai 1 zuwa 3.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Hasumiyoyi suna da matakai 1 zuwa 3. Da matakai 0 ba za a gan su daga sama ba, ba za a iya yin matakai 4 ko fiye ba.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole jimillar matakan hasumiyoyi ukun ta zama tubalan 7.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.explain: Yanayin da jimillar matakai ta zama 7 su ne (1, 3, 3), (3, 1, 3), (3, 3, 1), (2, 2, 3), (2, 3, 2), (3, 2, 2), hanyoyi 6 kenan. A kowane yanayi, tubalan saman 3 kaɗai kake gani daga sama, saboda haka kallon ya yi daidai.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Zaɓi ɗaya daga hanyoyin da ka ƙirƙira sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa kallon sama bai canza ba.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Faɗi tubalan da za a iya gani da waɗanda suke ɓoye idan aka duba daga sama.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Duba ko canza adadin matakan hasumiya yana canza adadin tubalan da ake gani daga sama.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: A hanyar da na zaɓa, wurare ukun jeren baya duk suna matakin jeren gaba ko ƙasa?
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka ba da dalilin 'suna ɓoye, saboda haka ba za a iya ganinsu'?
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan aka duba daga sama, tubalan saman 3 kaɗai ake gani, tubalan da ke ƙasa kuma tubalan sama suna ɓoye su. Saboda haka ko adadin matakai ya bambanta, kallon yana kama da iri ɗaya.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Na tara matakai 3, 3, da 1. Daga sama ana ganin tubalin saman guda ɗaya ga kowace hasumiya kawai, ƙananan matakai kuma suna ɓoye, ba za a iya ganin su ba.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: An bayyana ta amfani da lambobi.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.model.2: Daga sama, tubalan da ke ƙasa suna ɓoye cikin hasumiya kuma ba za a iya ganin su ba. Saboda haka siffar da kake gani ba ta canzawa.

z-m-03-02.title: Igiya da aka rataya tsakanin ƙusoshi biyu a bango: shin tsawonta ma iri ɗaya ne?
z-m-03-02.goal: Nemo layin da bai dace ba a tunanin cewa igiyoyi biyu masu farawa da ƙarewa wuri ɗaya dole ne su yi tsawo iri ɗaya, sannan ka bayyana abin da ake buƙata don tabbatar da daidaiton tsawonsu da yadda za a bincika.
z-m-03-02.material: Akwai ƙusoshi biyu a bango. Jia ta rataya igiya guda da ba ta miƙe sosai ba tsakanin ƙusoshin. Minho ya rataya wata igiya marar miƙewa a ƙusoshin biyun, amma ya sa ta saggy ta lanƙwashe ƙasa. Igiyoyin biyun sun fara daga ƙusoshin hagu, sun ƙare a na dama. Jia ta yi tunani haka.
z-m-03-02.thinking.0: Nemo ɓangaren tunani da aka tsallake
z-m-03-02.thinking.1: Tantance irin bayanin da ake buƙata
z-m-03-02.thinking.2: Bayyana hanyar bincike da sakamakon da ake tsammani
z-m-03-02.prereq.0: Sanin “tsawo/gajere” da kwatanta tsawon abubuwa madaidaiciya biyu ta haɗa ƙarshensu (matakin aji na 1)
z-m-03-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda na farko a tunanin Jia da ya fara yin kuskure.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.hint.0: Rarraba kowanne layi zuwa gaskiyar da ka bincika da ido da ra’ayin da aka samo daga gaskiyoyin.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.hint.1: Zana ka kwatanta siffar igiya ɗaya da aka ja ta miƙe da siffarta idan ta saggy.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.line.0: Igiya tawa ta miƙe, ta Minho kuma ta lanƙwashe ƙasa.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.line.1: Duk da haka, igiyoyin biyu suna rataye a ƙusa na hagu da na dama.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.line.2: Farkon da ƙarshen suna wuri ɗaya, saboda haka igiyoyin biyu suna da tsawo iri ɗaya.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka ko da mun ja igiyar Minho ta miƙe, tsawonta zai zama daidai da tawa.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne ya fara kuskure. Ko da farko da ƙarshe wuri ɗaya ne, tsawon na iya bambanta dangane da ko hanyar madaidaiciya ce ko karkatacciya. Layi na 4 ƙarshe ne da ya biyo tunanin layi na 3, saboda haka kuskure ne na baya. Layuka 1 da 2 sun bayyana abin da aka gani kamar yadda yake.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.prompt: Igiya ta Minho ma igiya ce marar miƙewa kamar ta Jia. A yanzu igiyar Minho kaɗai ce ta saggy. Wane ƙarin sharadi ake buƙata domin a ce igiyoyin biyu tsawonsu iri ɗaya ne?
z-m-03-02.s.s2.hint.0: Faɗi abin da ya bambanta game da yadda aka rataya igiyoyin biyu.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bincika ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko tsawon igiyar zai iya canzawa idan kowane sharadi ya canza.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.r.a: Launi ba shi da alaƙa da tsawo. Nemo abubuwan da suke da alaƙa da tsawon.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.o.b: Igiyoyin biyu sun fara a ƙusa na hagu kuma sun ƙare a na dama.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.r.b: An riga an bayar da wannan. Kamar yadda ka gani a matakin baya, farawa da ƙarewa wuri ɗaya ba ya ƙayyade tsawo.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.o.c: Igiyoyin biyu sun rataye a miƙe kuma a ƙarfafe.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.o.d: Ƙusoshin biyu suna tsayi ɗaya a bango.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.r.d: Ko ƙusoshin suna tsayi ɗaya ko a’a, wuraren rataye igiyoyin biyu iri ɗaya ne. Yadda aka rataya igiyar ne ya fi muhimmanci.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.explain: Idan aka rataya igiyoyi biyu a ƙusoshi guda, kuma duka sun miƙe, duka hanyoyi madaidaiciya ne, saboda haka tsawonsu iri ɗaya ne. Idan ko ɗaya ya saggy, wannan igiyar na iya fi tsawo.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.prompt: Kana son gano ko igiyar Minho tana da tsawo iri ɗaya da ta Jia. Rubuta yadda za ka bincika da sakamakon da kake tsammani.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin cire igiyoyin biyu daga ƙusoshin, a shimfiɗa su a kan tebur.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin abin da ke faruwa da sauran ƙarshen lokacin da ka daidaita ƙarshen guda na kowace igiya.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Hanyar da na bayyana da gaske tana nuna bambancin tsawon igiyoyin biyun?
z-m-03-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka haɗa dalilin sakamakon da kake tsammani da “saggy/miƙe”?
z-m-03-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunanin ko igiyoyin biyun na iya zama tsawo ɗaya?
z-m-03-02.s.s3.model.0: Ja igiyar Minho ta miƙe, sannan ka ajiye ta kusa da ta Jia. Ina tsammani igiyar da ta saggy za ta fi tsawo.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.model.1: Miƙe igiyoyin biyun, haɗa ƙarshensu guda, ka duba inda sauran ƙarshen suke; hakan zai nuna cewa tsawonsu na iya bambanta.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Sakamakon da ake tsammani gajere ne, amma ya bayyana hanyar da yiwuwar sakamakon duka.

z-m-03-03.title: Idan ka yanke takarda murabba’i sau ɗaya da yanka madaidaiciya, siffofin guntayen za su kasance yaya?
z-m-03-03.topic: Raba siffofi masu lebur (kusurwoyin guntayen da aka yanke da layi madaidaiciya)

z-m-03-07.s.s2.r.c: Kasancewarsu duka sun fi shuɗi tsawo ba ya nufin iri ɗaya suke. Wataƙila tsawonsu ya bambanta.

z-m-03-08.title: Idan siffar da aka gani daga sama da’ira ce, wane irin abu zai iya zama?
z-m-03-08.topic: Siffofin jiki (ga akwatin, silinda mai zagaye, da ƙwallo ta hanyoyi dabam-dabam bisa inda aka duba)
z-m-03-08.goal: Bincika ko siffar da aka gani daga alkibla guda kaɗai za ta iya tantance abu; rage zaɓuɓɓuka yayin da kake koyon siffofin daga wasu alkiblu, sannan ka yi hasashen siffar idan aka kwantar da shi gefe.
z-m-03-08.material: Akwai wani abu a kan tebur, wani allo kuma ya rufe sashensa ta yadda wani ɓangare kawai ake gani. Abun ɗaya ne daga cikin waɗannan: siffar akwati (mai fuskoki murabba’ai), siffar silinda (zagaye da lebur a sama da ƙasa kamar gwangwani), ko siffar ƙwallo. An ajiye shi a tsaye a ƙasa.
z-m-03-08.thinking.0: Yi tunanin duk yanayin da zai yiwu bisa bayani guda
z-m-03-08.thinking.1: Rage yanayin da zai yiwu da sabon bayani
z-m-03-08.thinking.2: Hasashen siffar da ke canzawa idan alkiblar kallo ta canza
z-m-03-08.prereq.0: Sanin siffofin akwati, silinda (gwangwani), da ƙwallo (matakin aji na 1)
z-m-03-08.s.s1.prompt: Ana ƙara alkiblar kallo ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane lokaci zaɓi abin da kake tsammanin abin yake.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin kallon waɗannan abubuwa ukun daga sama, ka faɗi yadda kowannensu yake gani.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.hint.1: Idan kana da gwangwani ko ƙwallo na gaske, kalle su daga sama da gefe, ka nemo abin da ya yi daidai da wanda ya bambanta.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Idan aka kalli ƙasa daga sama, yana kama da da’ira.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wane irin abu kake tunanin zai iya zama?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Akwati yana kama da murabba’i idan an gan shi daga sama, silinda da ƙwallo kuma suna kama da da’ira daga sama. Saboda haka da wannan bayani kaɗai yana da wuya a bambanta silinda da ƙwallo.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Siffar akwati ce. Abubuwan da ke kan tebur yawanci akwatuna ne.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ba ka bincika yadda abu mai kama da zagaye daga sama zai dace da akwati ba. Yaya akwati yake daga sama?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Siffar ƙwallo ce. Domin tana kama da da’ira.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ba ka bincika ko abubuwan da suke kama da da’ira guda ɗaya ne kawai ba. Yaya sauran abubuwan suke?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Silinda ce ko ƙwallo. Ba ta kama da akwati.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka yi tunanin duk yanayin da suke kama da da’ira.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Dukkan ukun za su iya yiwuwa. Kowanne abu yana kama da zagaye idan an kalle shi daga sama.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Akwati yana kama da murabba’i daga sama. Ba gaskiya ba ne cewa dukkan ukun za su iya yiwuwa.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Daga gefe yana kama da murabba’i, kuma saman da kasan lebur ne.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu wane irin abu kake tsammanin zai iya zama?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Abun da yake kama da da’ira daga sama da murabba’i daga gefe silinda ne. Ƙwallo tana kama da da’ira daga gefe ma, akwati kuma murabba’i ne daga sama.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Silinda ce. Daga sama tana kama da da’ira, daga gefe kuma murabba’i.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka haɗa siffofin da aka gani daga alkiblu biyu.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Siffar ƙwallo ce. Daga sama da’ira ce, saboda haka daga gefe ma haka za ta kasance.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ƙwallo tana kama da da’ira daga kowace alkibla. Bincika ko ta dace da siffar da aka gani daga gefe.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Siffar akwati ce. Domin tana kama da murabba’i daga gefe.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka duba siffar gefe kawai. Ka kuma yi la’akari da cewa daga sama da’ira ce.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Daga sama da’ira ce, daga gefe kuma murabba’i, saboda haka ba za a iya tantance abu ba.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ba ka bincika ko siffofin biyu sun dace da abu guda ba. Wane irin abu ne yake da siffofin biyun?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.info: An kwantar da wannan abu gefe kuma an jingina shi domin kada ya mirgina.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Idan ka kalli abun da aka kwantar gefe daga sama, yaya zai kasance?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan an kwantar da shi, gefensa ne yake fuskantar sama. Siffar murabba’in da ka gani daga gefe lokacin da yake tsaye yanzu za a gani daga sama. Ko abu ɗaya ne, siffarsa daga sama tana bambanta bisa yadda aka ajiye shi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Yana kama da da’ira. Daga sama kullum da’ira ce.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka ci gaba da ɗaukar siffar da’ira daga sama lokacin da yake tsaye. Idan an kwantar da shi, fuskar da take nuna sama ta bambanta.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Yana kama da da’irori biyu da suka haɗu. Domin akwai fuskoki biyu, sama da ƙasa.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ko da akwai fuskoki biyu sama da ƙasa, idan an kwantar da shi, gefensa ne yake fuskantar sama.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Yana kama da triangle. Idan an kwantar da shi, kusurwoyi masu kaifi suna bayyana.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ko an kwantar da silinda, babu kusurwa mai kaifi da ke bayyana. Ka yi tunanin siffar da ka gani daga gefe.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ka yi tunanin siffar da aka gani daga gefe tun farko za ta zama siffar da ake gani daga sama idan an kwantar da shi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ta yaya tunaninka ya canza tsakanin lokacin da ka san siffar daga sama kaɗai da lokacin da ka kuma san siffar daga gefe? Domin rage abubuwan da za su iya zama, wane ƙarin bayani ake buƙata?

z-m-03-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo ko akwai alkiblar da ƙwallo da silinda suke kama da juna.
